content_moderation.name: nsfw-image-detection-large
content_moderation.summary: 该模型专注于高精度检测图片中的NSFW内容，解决内容审核中的可靠性难题。其技术核心采用FocalNet骨干网络，通过聚焦多尺度特征提取，在保持效率的同时提升了对复杂场景的鲁棒性。实际应用中，你可以通过Hugging Face的transformers库快速集成，或使用官方提供的推理脚本进行批量处理，非常适合社交媒体、电商平台等需要自动化内容审核的场景。
content_moderation.summary_en: This model detects NSFW content in images with high accuracy, solving the need for reliable content moderation. It uses a FocalNet backbone, which efficiently captures multi-scale features for robust detection. You can integrate it via Hugging Face's transformers library or use the provided inference script for batch processing, making it suitable for social media, e-commerce, or any platform requiring automated moderation.

multimodal_understanding_generation.name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct
multimodal_understanding_generation.summary: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 是一个轻量级的 20 亿参数视觉语言模型，能够同时理解图像和文本，实现多模态对话与推理。其技术核心在于高效的跨模态融合架构，在保持较强推理能力的同时，模型尺寸足够小，适合在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。开发者可通过 Hugging Face Transformers 直接调用该模型，应用于视觉问答、图像描述生成，或构建能够结合视觉内容与文本输入的交互式 AI 助手，为实际场景提供灵活的多模态解决方案。
multimodal_understanding_generation.summary_en: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct is a lightweight 2-billion-parameter vision-language model that enables conversational AI to understand and reason about both images and text simultaneously. Its technical innovation lies in efficient multimodal fusion architecture that maintains strong reasoning capabilities while being small enough for edge deployment. Developers can use it through Hugging Face Transformers for applications like visual question answering, image captioning, or building interactive AI assistants that process visual content alongside text inputs.

multimodal_understanding_generation.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8
multimodal_understanding_generation.summary: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 是一个支持文本和图像输入的多模态MoE模型，专为高效对话AI设计。其核心技术是混合专家架构，总参数量35B但每次推理仅激活3B参数，大幅降低计算成本。FP8量化进一步加速推理并减少显存占用。你可以用它构建视觉语言聊天机器人、进行文档分析，或任何需要同时理解与生成的任务。通过Hugging Face Transformers库即可轻松调用，支持自动设备映射。
multimodal_understanding_generation.summary_en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 is a multimodal MoE model that handles text and image inputs, designed for efficient conversational AI. Its key innovation is the Mixture-of-Experts architecture with only 3B active parameters out of 35B total, drastically reducing compute cost. The FP8 quantization further speeds inference and lowers memory. Use it for building vision-language chatbots, document analysis, or any task needing both understanding and generation. Try it via Hugging Face Transformers with automatic device mapping.

model_quantization.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8
model_quantization.summary: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 是一个支持文本和图像输入的多模态MoE模型，专为高效对话AI设计。其核心技术是混合专家架构，总参数量35B但每次推理仅激活3B参数，大幅降低计算成本。FP8量化进一步加速推理并减少显存占用。你可以用它构建视觉语言聊天机器人、进行文档分析，或任何需要同时理解与生成的任务。通过Hugging Face Transformers库即可轻松调用，支持自动设备映射。
model_quantization.summary_en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 is a multimodal MoE model that handles text and image inputs, designed for efficient conversational AI. Its key innovation is the Mixture-of-Experts architecture with only 3B active parameters out of 35B total, drastically reducing compute cost. The FP8 quantization further speeds inference and lowers memory. Use it for building vision-language chatbots, document analysis, or any task needing both understanding and generation. Try it via Hugging Face Transformers with automatic device mapping.

multilingual_processing.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
multilingual_processing.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
multilingual_processing.summary_en: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 is a compact multilingual sentence encoder that solves the challenge of understanding semantic similarity across 50+ languages without language-specific models. It achieves this by distilling knowledge from larger multilingual transformers i…
